segments.text: A flammable can be simply described as a substance that will readily catch fire and burn.
segments.zh: 易燃物可以简单地描述为容易着火并燃烧的物质。

segments.text: Xylene is a commonly used flammable substance.
segments.zh: 二甲苯是一种常用的易燃物质。

segments.text: There can be two identical amounts sitting side by side in identical dishes.
segments.zh: 两份等量的二甲苯，可以并排放在一模一样的皿里，

segments.text: Yet one will ignite, the other one won't.
segments.zh: 然而一份会着火，另一份却不会。

segments.text: The reason? The xylene that didn't ignite was cooled by dry ice.
segments.zh: 原因是什么？没有着火的那份二甲苯是用干冰冷却过的。

segments.text: The other was heated to just over 81 degrees, the flashpoint of xylene.
segments.zh: 另一份则被加热到略高于 81 度，也就是二甲苯的闪点。

segments.text: Flashpoint is the lowest temperature at which a substance gives off vapor that will burn.
segments.zh: 闪点是一种物质释放出可燃蒸气的最低温度。

segments.text: One of the first things you need to remember when you're dealing with flammables and explosives
segments.zh: 在处理易燃物和爆炸物时，你首先需要记住的一点是：

segments.text: is that it's the vapor that a substance gives off that burns, not the substance itself.
segments.zh: 燃烧的是物质释放出的蒸气，而不是物质本身。

segments.text: Flammables and explosives are two classes of materials that can always be dangerous.
segments.zh: 易燃物和爆炸物是两类始终具有危险性的物质。

segments.text: While flammables can ignite and burn, explosives are subject to very rapid chemical reaction or decomposition
segments.zh: 易燃物会着火燃烧，而爆炸物会发生非常迅速的化学反应或分解，

segments.text: and can release gas and heat with potentially violent results.
segments.zh: 并可能释放出气体和热量，造成可能很剧烈的后果。

segments.text: Flammables and explosives are both materials that you want to be very careful with.
segments.zh: 易燃物和爆炸物都是你需要非常小心对待的物质。

segments.text: Let's look at another highly flammable material, gasoline.
segments.zh: 我们再来看另一种高度易燃的物质：汽油。

segments.text: Its vapors ignite easily at temperatures as low as negative 45 degrees Fahrenheit.
segments.zh: 它的蒸气在低至零下 45 华氏度的温度下就很容易点燃。

segments.text: Even when it's at its flashpoint and a spark is created, gasoline may not catch fire.
segments.zh: 即使汽油处于闪点并且产生了火花，它也不一定会着火。

segments.text: Whether it does will depend on the gasoline's fuel-air mixture and limits of flammability.
segments.zh: 会不会着火，取决于汽油的燃料—空气混合比和燃烧极限。

segments.text: Materials have both lower and upper limits of flammability.
segments.zh: 物质都有燃烧下限和燃烧上限。

segments.text: A substance's lower flammable limit is the minimum percentage of vapor to air
segments.zh: 一种物质的燃烧下限，是发生点燃所需的

segments.text: that's required for ignition to take place.
segments.zh: 蒸气与空气的最低百分比。

segments.text: The upper flammable limit is the percentage of vapor to air beyond which ignition is no longer possible.
segments.zh: 燃烧上限是蒸气与空气的百分比，超过这一比例就不可能再点燃。

segments.text: For example, the limits of flammability for diethyl ether range from 1.9% to 36.5% by volume of air.
segments.zh: 例如，乙醚的燃烧极限范围是空气体积的 1.9% 到 36.5%。

segments.text: This means it will ignite if the atmosphere is only 1.9% ether,
segments.zh: 这意味着即使空气中只有 1.9% 的乙醚，它也会被点燃，

segments.text: and it can't ignite if the atmosphere contains more than 36.5% ether.
segments.zh: 而如果空气中含有超过 36.5% 的乙醚，它就无法点燃。

segments.text: Remember, most lower limits are reached quickly, so it can be very easy for a fire or explosion to erupt in a lab.
segments.zh: 记住，大多数燃烧下限很快就会达到，所以实验室里很容易突然发生火灾或爆炸。

segments.text: And keep this in mind.
segments.zh: 还要记住这一点：

segments.text: If there is enough vapor in the air to create a flammable atmosphere,
segments.zh: 如果空气中的蒸气足以形成易燃环境，

segments.text: the atmosphere will usually be above toxic limits as well.
segments.zh: 那么这个环境通常也会超过毒性限值。

segments.text: In addition to having their flammability limits affect when they will burn,
segments.zh: 除了燃烧极限会影响它们何时燃烧之外，

segments.text: all flammables also have an ignition temperature.
segments.zh: 所有易燃物还有一个自燃温度。

segments.text: This is the minimum temperature that is required to cause self-contained combustion,
segments.zh: 这是引起自持燃烧所需的最低温度，

segments.text: regardless of the heat source that is involved.
segments.zh: 与所涉及的热源无关。

segments.text: Carbon disulfide, for instance, has an ignition temperature of 80 degrees centigrade.
segments.zh: 例如，二硫化碳的自燃温度是 80 摄氏度。

segments.text: As a result, it can easily ignite via a nearby light bulb or steam line.
segments.zh: 因此，附近的一个灯泡或蒸汽管道就很容易把它点燃。

segments.text: Similarly, the surface temperature of a hot plate will ignite diethyl ether.
segments.zh: 同样，加热板的表面温度就会点燃乙醚。

segments.text: So when you're working with flammable and explosive materials,
segments.zh: 所以当你使用易燃和易爆物质时，

segments.text: you should remove equipment that will cause heat or sparks from your work area if at all possible.
segments.zh: 只要有可能，就应该把会产生热量或火花的设备移出工作区域。

segments.text: Even things like stirrers and pumps can cause problems.
segments.zh: 即使是搅拌器和泵之类的东西也可能造成问题。

segments.text: And never use an open flame or a hot plate to heat flammables.
segments.zh: 绝不要用明火或加热板来加热易燃物，

segments.text: Instead, use a heating mantle or water bath.
segments.zh: 而要使用加热套或水浴。

segments.text: Static electricity, which can be generated just by walking across a rug,
segments.zh: 静电，仅仅走过一块地毯就可能产生，

segments.text: is another thing that you need to be concerned about.
segments.zh: 也是你需要关注的另一件事。

segments.text: So whenever you can, be sure to use static guard devices
segments.zh: 所以只要有可能，在使用易燃物和爆炸物时，

segments.text: when you're working with flammables and explosives.
segments.zh: 一定要使用防静电装置。

segments.text: If you have any questions, consult the safety data sheets of the chemicals that you're using
segments.zh: 如果你有任何疑问，请查阅你所用化学品的安全技术说明书，

segments.text: for information on the flashpoints, ignition temperatures and flammability limits.
segments.zh: 了解闪点、自燃温度和燃烧极限等信息。

segments.text: Many gases that are used in laboratories can be both flammable and explosive,
segments.zh: 实验室里使用的许多气体可能既易燃又易爆，

segments.text: so it's important to know how to store gas cylinders as well.
segments.zh: 所以了解如何存放气瓶也很重要。

segments.text: Strap or chain flammable gas cylinders securely to benches or wall racks
segments.zh: 要用绑带或链条把易燃气体气瓶牢牢固定在实验台或墙架上，

segments.text: so they don't fall and knock valves open or break hose lines.
segments.zh: 以免它们倒下撞开阀门或折断软管。

segments.text: Fittings and hoses should be checked regularly to see if they've developed any leaks.
segments.zh: 应定期检查接头和软管，看是否出现了泄漏。

segments.text: Don't store gases that could react next to one another.
segments.zh: 不要把可能相互反应的气体放在一起存放。

segments.text: Maintaining the correct labeling on a cylinder is important as well.
segments.zh: 保持气瓶上标签的正确也很重要。

segments.text: You can't rely on the paint color to tell you what's in it.
segments.zh: 你不能依靠涂漆的颜色来判断里面装的是什么。

segments.text: Many suppliers don't adhere to a strict color code.
segments.zh: 许多供应商并不严格遵守颜色编码。

segments.text: When you take a cylinder out of storage, check all connections for leaks once again.
segments.zh: 当你从库房取出一个气瓶时，要再次检查所有连接处是否泄漏。

segments.text: Use a dilute soap solution at fittings and valves.
segments.zh: 在接头和阀门处涂上稀肥皂水，

segments.text: Bubbles will tell you if a leak exists.
segments.zh: 如果有泄漏，就会冒出气泡。

segments.text: In addition to sharing some characteristics with flammables,
segments.zh: 除了和易燃物有一些共同特点之外，

segments.text: explosives have unique attributes of their own.
segments.zh: 爆炸物还有自己独特的特性。

segments.text: Many of them are affected dramatically by increases in temperature.
segments.zh: 其中许多会受到温度升高的显著影响，

segments.text: They will decompose quickly or become dangerously reactive.
segments.zh: 它们会迅速分解或变得极具反应性。

segments.text: Light, mechanical shock and certain catalysts can also start a reaction.
segments.zh: 光、机械冲击和某些催化剂也可能引发反应。

segments.text: You'll also need to be concerned about mixtures when you think about explosives.
segments.zh: 考虑爆炸物时，你还需要关注混合物。

segments.text: Some chemicals form an explosive compound when they're brought together,
segments.zh: 有些化学品放在一起就会形成爆炸性化合物，

segments.text: such as calcium carbide and water.
segments.zh: 比如碳化钙和水。

segments.text: Impurities in a sample can be dangerous as well.
segments.zh: 样品中的杂质也可能很危险。

segments.text: Organic peroxides can form on containers of diethyl ether.
segments.zh: 有机过氧化物会在乙醚容器上形成。

segments.text: These peroxides are notoriously unstable and explosive.
segments.zh: 这些过氧化物是出了名的不稳定且易爆炸。

segments.text: They're also highly flammable and far more susceptible to shock than even dynamite.
segments.zh: 它们还高度易燃，而且对冲击的敏感程度甚至远超炸药。

segments.text: Something as simple as the friction caused by opening a contaminated jar can cause an explosion.
segments.zh: 仅仅是打开一个被污染的瓶子时产生的摩擦，就可能引起爆炸。

segments.text: To make sure that you're familiar with any of the problems that could surface with these substances,
segments.zh: 为确保你了解这些物质可能出现的任何问题，

segments.text: check your safety data sheets and other guides before you handle or store them.
segments.zh: 在搬运或储存它们之前，要查阅安全技术说明书和其他指南。

segments.text: Ventilation is particularly important when you're working with flammable and explosive chemicals.
segments.zh: 在使用易燃和易爆化学品时，通风尤其重要。

segments.text: You must have enough ventilation to keep the vapor in the air
segments.zh: 你必须有足够的通风，使空气中的蒸气

segments.text: from reaching your material's lower flammable limits.
segments.zh: 达不到你所用物质的燃烧下限。

segments.text: Working under a hood can help to confine and remove flammable and toxic vapors.
segments.zh: 在通风柜内操作有助于限制和排除易燃及有毒蒸气。

segments.text: Local ventilation controls also help prevent flashback,
segments.zh: 局部通风控制还有助于防止回火，

segments.text: the accidental reverse flow of flame back to a container.
segments.zh: 也就是火焰意外地反向回流到容器中。

segments.text: But in some cases, you'll need to use auxiliary ventilation when working with flammables and explosives.
segments.zh: 但在某些情况下，使用易燃物和爆炸物时你还需要使用辅助通风。

segments.text: How you transport flammable and explosive materials is also critical.
segments.zh: 如何运送易燃和易爆物质也至关重要。

segments.text: They should always be carried in secondary containers.
segments.zh: 它们应始终放在二次容器中携带。

segments.text: Rubber acid carriers are a good choice.
segments.zh: 橡胶酸瓶提篮是个不错的选择，

segments.text: Plastic jacket overpacks also work well.
segments.zh: 塑料外套式外包装也很好用。

segments.text: If you need to cross any uneven surfaces, be sure to use carts with large wheels.
segments.zh: 如果需要经过不平的地面，一定要使用大轮子的推车。

segments.text: Don't use instrument, equipment, or mail carts.
segments.zh: 不要使用仪器车、设备车或邮件车，

segments.text: They're too easy to tip over, and chemicals can easily be knocked off of them too.
segments.zh: 它们太容易翻倒，化学品也很容易从上面被碰掉。

segments.text: Every chemical should have a specific storage place where it's returned to after each use.
segments.zh: 每种化学品都应该有一个固定的存放位置，每次用完都放回原处。

segments.text: Flammables and explosives are no exception.
segments.zh: 易燃物和爆炸物也不例外。

segments.text: Avoid locations that have exposure to heat or direct sunlight.
segments.zh: 避开受热或阳光直射的位置。

segments.text: Flammable liquids should be stored in approved safety containers.
segments.zh: 易燃液体应存放在经认可的安全容器中。

segments.text: Red containers with yellow tape identify substances having low flashpoints.
segments.zh: 贴有黄色胶带的红色容器标识的是低闪点物质。

segments.text: Arrestor spouts help prevent flashback.
segments.zh: 带阻火器的倒嘴有助于防止回火。

segments.text: Be sure to label the containers.
segments.zh: 一定要给容器贴上标签。

segments.text: You don't want any confusion where flammables are concerned.
segments.zh: 涉及易燃物时，你可不希望出现任何混淆。

segments.text: Storing your chemicals on a benchtop is not a good idea.
segments.zh: 把化学品存放在实验台面上不是个好主意。

segments.text: It's too easy to knock them over, and on a bench they're not protected from fire.
segments.zh: 它们太容易被碰倒，而且放在台面上无法防火。

segments.text: Inhood storage is also unadvisable.
segments.zh: 存放在通风柜内也是不可取的。

segments.text: The containers interfere with the airflow in the hood,
segments.zh: 容器会干扰通风柜内的气流，

segments.text: and the chemicals increase the number of materials that could be involved in a hood fire.
segments.zh: 而且这些化学品会增加通风柜火灾中可能涉及的物质数量。

segments.text: Amounts of flammable and explosive chemicals exceeding one liter in volume
segments.zh: 体积超过一升的易燃和易爆化学品，

segments.text: should be stored in approved flammables cabinets.
segments.zh: 应存放在经认可的易燃品柜中。

segments.text: The cabinets don't have to be vented, but if they are, the vent pipe should have a flame arrestor.
segments.zh: 这种柜子不一定要通风，但如果通风，排气管就应该装有阻火器。

segments.text: In some areas, local building codes may prohibit venting cabinets into the outside air.
segments.zh: 在某些地区，当地的建筑规范可能禁止把柜子排风排到室外。

segments.text: Keep cabinet doors closed and locked.
segments.zh: 保持柜门关闭并上锁。

segments.text: Never store flammables or explosives in a lab refrigerator unless it's been certified as explosion proof.
segments.zh: 除非实验室冰箱经过防爆认证，否则绝不要在里面存放易燃物或爆炸物。

segments.text: The National Fire Protection Association and your facility's policies
segments.zh: 美国消防协会以及你们设施的规定

segments.text: regulate how much flammable and explosive material can be stored within lab areas.
segments.zh: 限制了实验室区域内可以存放的易燃和易爆物质的数量。

segments.text: You should consult your supervisor to determine what the permitted storage levels are.
segments.zh: 你应该向主管咨询，确定允许的存放量是多少。

segments.text: Safe work practices also play an important role when you're using flammables and explosives.
segments.zh: 使用易燃物和爆炸物时，安全的作业方法也起着重要作用。

segments.text: When you're working with them, use the smallest amounts possible to attain the desired reaction.
segments.zh: 使用它们时，要用能够达到预期反应的尽可能少的量。

segments.text: If there's a potential for explosion, place your equipment behind a blast shield.
segments.zh: 如果有爆炸的可能，就把设备放在防爆护罩后面。

segments.text: Wear a face shield and appropriate gloves.
segments.zh: 戴上面罩和合适的手套。

segments.text: You should also use a lab coat that's made from a slow burning material.
segments.zh: 你还应该穿用缓燃材料制成的实验服。

segments.text: Make frequent checks of stored containers. Look for evidence of corrosion or contamination.
segments.zh: 经常检查存放的容器，留意是否有腐蚀或污染的迹象。

segments.text: Push containers back from shelf edges if they've gotten too close.
segments.zh: 如果容器离架子边缘太近，就把它们往里推。

segments.text: Disposing of waste from flammable and explosive materials can be tricky.
segments.zh: 处置易燃和易爆物质的废物可能很棘手。

segments.text: This is another place where you should consult safety data sheets.
segments.zh: 这又是一个你应该查阅安全技术说明书的地方。

segments.text: Be sure to take all the appropriate precautions.
segments.zh: 一定要采取所有适当的预防措施。

segments.text: Very few of these materials can safely go down the drain.
segments.zh: 这些物质中极少有能安全倒入下水道的。

segments.text: Generally, water treatment plants cannot filter out toxic substances like flammables.
segments.zh: 一般来说，水处理厂无法滤除易燃物之类的有毒物质。

segments.text: If you are permitted to use drain disposal, flammable should always be diluted so they don't pose a fire hazard.
segments.zh: 如果允许你倒入下水道处置，易燃物必须先稀释，使其不构成火灾危险。

segments.text: Simple reactions inside pipes can cause explosions.
segments.zh: 管道内的简单反应就可能引起爆炸。

segments.text: You may be able to recycle some of your chemicals, depending on what you're working with.
segments.zh: 根据你所使用的物质，你也许可以回收部分化学品。

segments.text: But never wash explosive residues down a drain or schedule them for recycling.
segments.zh: 但绝不要把爆炸性残留物冲进下水道，也不要把它们安排回收。

segments.text: Consult your supervisor regarding how to dispose of these wastes.
segments.zh: 关于如何处置这些废物，请咨询你的主管。

segments.text: More than likely, you'll need to package up your waste for disposal.
segments.zh: 很可能你需要把废物包装好再进行处置。

segments.text: Waste containers should be properly labeled and placed in a separate area for pickup.
segments.zh: 废物容器应正确贴上标签，并放在单独的区域等待收集。

segments.text: You also need to ask your supervisor or safety officer about federal and local disposal regulations.
segments.zh: 你还需要向主管或安全员了解联邦和地方的处置法规。

segments.text: Your facility has a complete plan on how to dispose of chemical waste, so read it.
segments.zh: 你们设施有一份关于如何处置化学废物的完整计划，所以要读一读。

segments.text: Remember, you're the one who is ultimately responsible for the disposal arrangements for the materials that you use.
segments.zh: 记住，对你所用物质的处置安排，最终负责的是你自己。

segments.text: So be sure you know what you're doing.
segments.zh: 所以一定要清楚自己在做什么。

segments.text: When you're working with flammable and explosive materials, it's especially important to know what to do in case of an emergency.
segments.zh: 使用易燃和易爆物质时，知道在紧急情况下该怎么做尤其重要。

segments.text: To start, read through your facility's emergency plan.
segments.zh: 首先，通读你们设施的应急预案。

segments.text: Create contingency plans for spill situations.
segments.zh: 针对溅洒情况制定应急计划。

segments.text: Remember that flammable liquids spread quickly.
segments.zh: 记住，易燃液体扩散得很快。

segments.text: The larger the spill area, the greater the chance of fire.
segments.zh: 溅洒面积越大，着火的可能性就越大。

segments.text: So all ignition sources in the lab should be turned off.
segments.zh: 所以应关闭实验室里所有的点火源。

segments.text: Keep spill cleanup equipment and materials nearby.
segments.zh: 把溅洒清理设备和材料放在附近。

segments.text: Personal protective equipment is also important.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备也很重要。

segments.text: See your supervisor about respirator training.
segments.zh: 关于呼吸器培训，请找你的主管。

segments.text: Remember, vermiculite absorbance don't keep vapors from rising into the air.
segments.zh: 记住，蛭石吸附剂并不能阻止蒸气升到空气中。

segments.text: Ask your supervisor about using activated carbon absorbance, some of which combat this problem.
segments.zh: 关于使用活性炭吸附剂，请咨询你的主管，其中一些能够解决这个问题。

segments.text: When you're working with flammables and explosives, you should always think about what you should do in case of an emergency.
segments.zh: 使用易燃物和爆炸物时，你应该始终想好在紧急情况下该怎么做。

segments.text: Re-read your facility's emergency plan.
segments.zh: 重新阅读你们设施的应急预案。

segments.text: Know the locations of fire extinguishers and emergency safety equipment, but only use them if you've been properly trained to do so.
segments.zh: 知道灭火器和应急安全设备的位置，但只有在受过正规培训后才能使用它们。

segments.text: Study evacuation maps and know where your exits are.
segments.zh: 研究疏散图，知道出口在哪里。

segments.text: With a fire or explosion, evacuating your lab may be the only thing you can do.
segments.zh: 发生火灾或爆炸时，撤离实验室可能是你唯一能做的事。

segments.text: Because they're always dangerous, working safely with flammables and explosives requires you to know what you're doing and maintain your focus at all times.
segments.zh: 由于易燃物和爆炸物始终是危险的，安全地使用它们要求你清楚自己在做什么，并时刻保持专注。

segments.text: Let's review.
segments.zh: 我们来回顾一下。

segments.text: Know which of the materials you work with are flammable or explosive and what their characteristics are.
segments.zh: 了解你所使用的物质中哪些是易燃或易爆的，以及它们有哪些特性。

segments.text: When you're working with flammables and explosives, make sure there are no potential ignition sources nearby.
segments.zh: 使用易燃物和爆炸物时，确保附近没有潜在的点火源。

segments.text: Be sure you have enough ventilation to remove volatile fumes and vapors from your work area.
segments.zh: 确保有足够的通风，把挥发性烟气和蒸气从工作区域排走。

segments.text: Know how the flammable and explosive materials you work with should be handled and stored.
segments.zh: 了解你所使用的易燃和易爆物质应该如何搬运和储存。

segments.text: And be prepared in the event a flammable or explosive emergency occurs.
segments.zh: 并为可能发生的易燃或爆炸紧急情况做好准备。

segments.text: By being on your toes and taking appropriate safety measures, you'll be able to work with flammables and explosive materials safely and securely.
segments.zh: 只要保持警觉并采取适当的安全措施，你就能安全、稳妥地使用易燃和易爆物质。
